description: A script for querying and reporting issues and pull requests in a specific release branch of a GitHub repository, focusing on backports, security fixes, and stability fixes, with output options in JSON or reStructuredText.

classes.name: Backport
classes.description: A class encapsulating logic for retrieving and processing pull requests and issues related to backports in a GitHub repository.

methods.name: by_date_range
methods.description: Creates a Backport instance with pull requests within a specified date range, excluding certain PRs.

methods.name: by_included_prs
methods.description: Creates a Backport instance with specified included pull requests.

methods.name: sanitize_title
methods.description: Sanitizes issue titles for output formatting.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Prints issues in a formatted list.

methods.name: get_issues
methods.description: Retrieves issues associated with the pull requests in the backport set.

methods.name: get_pulls
methods.description: Returns the list of pull requests.

methods.name: get_pulls_without_issues
methods.description: Returns pull requests lacking associated issues.

methods.name: get_pulls_with_invalid_issues
methods.description: Returns pull requests referencing invalid issues.
